name: CA-20
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Vince Fong with large fundraising edge ($1.85M vs ~$17K)
Democratic challenger is minimally funded and in debt
model.rationale: The R+16 district, Fong's incumbency and overwhelming financial advantage, and markets pricing him near 97% all point to a safe Republican hold; the Democratic campaign shows no meaningful resources or outside support.
model.watch: Any unexpected late polling or outside spending on the Democratic side would be the only sign of movement, but none is currently evident.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Vince Fong, the Republican incumbent, is heavily favored in this Central Valley district that leans Republican by about 16 points. He advanced to the general election and has raised roughly $1.85 million, while Democratic challenger Sandra Van Scotter has raised about $17,000 and reports negative cash on hand. No outside spending or independent polls are on record in this race.

Prediction markets give Fong about a 97% chance of winning, and no expert raters flag the seat as competitive. With a well-funded incumbent in a strongly favorable district and an under-resourced challenger, the race is rated Safe Republican.
